desc: Build prefix function and deterministic KMP automaton for states 0..m with fallback from state m.
Precompute per-state reachability masks and first character to state m for fast backward DP.
Implement backward feasibility DP over L = n + m - 1 positions with T/F constraints.
Implement greedy left-to-right reconstruction using feasibility masks.
Run the existing solution against sample tests and key edge cases; if it fails, switch to a simpler bitset DP or alternative approach.
